name: fall_elderly
title: Evaluation After a Recent Fall in an Older Adult
description: Older adult presents for evaluation after a fall at home. Covers fall risk assessment using the 4Ms Age-Friendly Health Systems framework, polypharmacy review, orthostatic hypotension, and mild cognitive impairment.
clinicalInvariants: Conditions: hypertension, type 2 DM, osteoarthritis (knees, hands), mild cognitive impairment
Core medications: lisinopril 10mg daily, metformin 500mg BID, acetaminophen PRN, oxybutynin 5mg daily, glyburide 2.5mg daily, omeprazole 20mg daily
Chief complaint: fall ~5 days ago reaching for item in kitchen, landed on right knee
Clinical findings: MOCA 22/30, TUG 14 seconds (needs arms to arise), mild orthostatic drop (~14/6 mmHg)
Assessment: fall from imbalance + orthostatic changes, OA affecting gait, MCI contributing to safety concerns, polypharmacy
Management: consistent cane use, PT referral, medication review, safety evaluation, ACP documentation, 4-week follow-up
4Ms framework provider questions remain verbatim across all variants
SP responses to 4Ms questions remain substantively identical across variants
